Thus the written assignment is compatible with a presheaf target A-hat. This checks the displayed typing/variance only; it does not establish any surrounding result or settle j/J from mathematics.

I compared the lower candidate x→B/x with the displayed j_A:Cat→A-hat. If B is the intended numerator and x is an object of B, then B/x is a category and the assignment has objects of B as inputs; it is not literally the same type as Cat→B-hat. This is a conditional scope/type check, consistent with the writer asking whether the description is wrong. It does not resolve the numerator B/A or any cancelled word, and no mathematical correction was inserted.
